import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of mrt
sns.histplot(invasion_success['mrt'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between mrt and number.of.invaded.plots
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between mrt and number.of.invaded.plots')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between mrt and area.of.occupancy.10km
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between mrt and area.of.occupancy.10km')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between introduction pathway and number.of.invaded.plots
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Introduction Pathway and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between introduction pathway and area.of.occupancy.10km
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Introduction Pathway and Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.show()

# Perform a multiple linear regression to examine the interaction between mrt and intro.pathway on number.of.invaded.plots
# Convert 'intro.pathway' to a categorical variable
invasion_success['intro.pathway'] = pd.Categorical(invasion_success['intro.pathway'])

# Create interaction term
invasion_success['mrt_intro_pathway'] = invasion_success['mrt'] * invasion_success['intro.pathway'].cat.codes

# Define the model
X = invasion_success[['mrt', 'intro.pathway', 'mrt_intro_pathway']]
y = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots']

# Add a constant to the model
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the model summary
model.summary()

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Prepare the data for regression
X = invasion_success[['mrt', 'intro.pathway']]
y = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots']

# Create a ColumnTransformer to one-hot encode the 'intro.pathway' variable
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ('one_hot', OneHotEncoder(), ['intro.pathway'])
    ],
    remainder='drop'
)

# Create a pipeline with the preprocessor and the linear regression model
model = make_pipeline(preprocessor, LinearRegression())

# Fit the model
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.named_steps['linearregression'].coef_
intercept = model.named_steps['linearregression'].intercept_

coefficients, intercept

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, PolynomialFeatures
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

# Load the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Prepare the data for regression with interaction terms
X = invasion_success[['mrt', 'intro.pathway']]
y = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots']

# Create a ColumnTransformer to one-hot encode the 'intro.pathway' variable
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ('one_hot', OneHotEncoder(), ['intro.pathway'])
    ],
    remainder='drop'
)

# Create a pipeline with the preprocessor, PolynomialFeatures for interaction terms, and the linear regression model
model = make_pipeline(preprocessor, PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), LinearRegression())

# Fit the model
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients
coefficients = model.named_steps['linearregression'].coef_
intercept = model.named_steps['linearregression'].intercept_

coefficients, intercept
